stickers.description_zh: 团斑闭眼微笑，捧着一杯冒热气的茶
stickers.description_en: Tuanban smiles with eyes closed and holds a warm mug

stickers.description_zh: 团斑举起两只肉垫，笑得很开心
stickers.description_en: Tuanban beams and raises both paws in excitement

stickers.description_zh: 团斑睁大眼睛，旁边有蓝色问号
stickers.description_en: Tuanban looks puzzled beside a blue question mark

stickers.description_zh: 团斑窝在蓝色软垫上安心打盹
stickers.description_en: Tuanban naps peacefully on a soft blue pillow
